summary: A broad gap-down at the open: the Nifty is off about 0.75% below 23,000, mid- and smallcaps are each down about 0.6%, and auto, FMCG, metal and realty are all more than 1% lower.

detail.leaders: Few; defence (Bharat Dynamics) on its order win
detail.laggards: Hindalco, Max Healthcare, Kotak Bank; financials (Bajaj Finance, HDFC Bank); auto, FMCG, metal, realty
detail.tone: Worse than the pre-open read: Gift Nifty had pointed to about −69 points, but the Nifty opened down 174 at 22,966 as oil jumped on Trump's rejection of Iran's Hormuz offer. Selling is broad, not confined to oil-sensitive names.
watch: RBI defence of the rupee near 96
